description: Get token transfers for an address within an age range, optionally for one token.

address.description: Blockchain address whose token transfers to return.

age_from.description: Start of the timestamp range to include, as a date or datetime string.

age_to.description: End of the timestamp range to include, as a date or datetime string.

chain_id.description: Chain ID as a string, such as "1" for Ethereum.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

token.description: Token to filter by, matched against its address, symbol, or name.

name: get_token_transfers_by_address
